sentences.text:
Respondent/complainant  **********
Advocate for Petitioner/accused: POSANI AKASH Advocate for PUBLIC PROSECUTOR Respondent/complainant:
CORAM : SRI JUSTICE HARINATH.N DATE : 12th March 2025 P C:
1.

The learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are arraigned as A.1 and A.2 in Crime No.164 of 2024 of III Town police station, Visakhapatnam, for the alleged offences under sections 406, 407, 420, 465,
467, 468, 471, 477 read with sections 120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. The learned Senior Counsel further submits that the petitioners are the Directors of the company by name 'Sunray Green Space Private Limited' and hold 35% of the stake in the company.

The 2nd respondent/de facto complainant also holds 35% of the stake in the company, while the remaining Contd...2p...
shareholding is held by third parties.

The entire allegation of the 2nd respondent/de facto complainant is that the petitioners have started a few more companies without the knowledge or consent of the 2nd respondent and that the funds of the company, in which the de facto complainant has an interest, were transferred to the other companies started by the petitioners.

It is also alleged that the services of the staff, who are on the rolls of Sunray Green Space Private Limited, were utilized for the other companies, resulting in a reduction in the turnover of the company.

As such,
the acts of the petitioners are oppressive in nature.

The learned senior counsel further submits that,
on a similar set of facts, the 2nd respondent/ de facto complainant has filed Company Petition No.7/241/244/AMR/2024 before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Amaravati Bench at Indukuri Appala Raja Varma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110710247/
1 Mangalagiri.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The issues of oppression and mismanagement ought to be exclusively dealt with by the National Company Law Tribunal.
It is also submitted that the 2nd respondent has filed I.A. No.22 of 2024 in the Company Petition, seeking a direction to conduct a forensic audit of the company.
The same is pending before the NCLT, Amaravati Bench.
3. Considering the submissions of the learned Senior counsel, this Court deems it appropriate to stay all further proceedings in Crime No.164 of 2024 of III Town police station, Visakhapatnam.
4. Issue notice to the 2nd respondent.
Contd...3p...
5. The learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the 2nd respondent and file proof of service in the registry.
